userCompletionSentence: 사용자는 T5 전체 상태를 암호화 백업해 다른 컴퓨터의 격리 상태에 복원하고, 비밀과 외부 계정만 다시 연결한 뒤 미완료 Work를 외부 효과 중복 없이 이어간다.
positiveControls: Alpha1 can close Work admission and drain the one runtime before snapshot.
Conversation, Memory, Work, Run, Automation, Attachment and Capability stores already validate their own canonical formats.
Memory portable export already excludes local absolute file paths and never-store values.

incidents.oracle: all canonical component heads belong to one drained snapshot generation
Session, Message, Work, Run, Automation and Artifact references resolve before activation
secret plaintext and platform credential material occurrences equal zero
included, excluded_large and unavailable Artifact states are explicit and digest-bound
wrong password reveals no manifest content and changes no destination state
partial, changed or version-incompatible bundle changes no destination state
restore validates in a new sibling root before one atomic activation
restored unknown or dispatched effects are never blind retried
portable manifest contains no source absolute path or OS-specific authority claim
local deletion never claims provider, external-service or separate-backup deletion

copying Keychain, DPAPI or OAuth secret plaintext
calling a folder copy a relationship-verified backup
activating restore before every component and reference validates
